trigger: a PR adding or renewing a .grypeignore.yaml entry

classification_rationale: docs claim an owner-review request for every acceptance file

trigger: an entry written without package_type
summary: package_type is optional, so a type-less grype acceptance covers the same name and exact version of every package type; still one name and version (verified with real grype).
classification_rationale: optional hardening, no contradiction

trigger: a run without --report-dir and with GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY set, grype failing early

classification_rationale: summary row contradicted the verdict

trigger: a grype gate.txt missing while Trivy's passes
summary: The publish journal and the release check required only Trivy's reports; grype's were optional although the gate now always writes them. Raised independently by build-ci (bci-3), release-deploy (rd-1) and compliance-officer (co-1, who derived MEDIUM without E6).
classification_rationale: co-1 derived MEDIUM (I3, E0) without E6; sec-4/rd-1 derived LOW with E6 (gate exit status enforces today). Resolved by implementing the requirement, so the band is not adjudicated further.

trigger: the release's changelog assembly of this fragment beside #8315's and #6711's
summary: The new fragment contradicted the #8315 fragment ('Alpine gateway stays on 28.5.0.2', 'OTP runtime not seen') and #6711's #6740 re-pin in the same release; other PRs' fragments may not be edited (changelog.d/README rule 1). Also raised by gateway-erlang (gw-1).
classification_rationale: fixed by stating the supersession in this change's fragment

trigger: merging with the 0000- placeholder fragment names
summary: Both fragments carry the 0000- placeholder (PR number unknown, by instruction); rename to the PR number before merge, which also orders them after #8315's. Re-check the CVE counts at that time (co-5). Raised also by release-deploy (g8-rd-2) and compliance-officer (co-5).
classification_rationale: process step pending the PR number

trigger: a reader of the rebar target-string example

trigger: a reader of the single long fragment

classification_rationale: split done

trigger: hexpm publishes the next OTP 28 patch only under a newer Alpine patch tag

classification_rationale: comment contradicted Dependabot behaviour
